build_command_map.cpu_usage: sh -c 'read _ u1 n1 s1 i1 io1 ir1 si1 st1 _ < /proc/stat; sleep 1; read _ u2 n2 s2 i2 io2 ir2 si2 st2 _ < /proc/stat; idle=$((i2+io2-i1-io1)); total=$((u2+n2+s2+i2+io2+ir2+si2+st2-u1-n1-s1-i1-io1-ir1-si1-st1)); if [ "$total" -le 0 ]; then printf "0.0\n"; else awk -v idle="$idle" -v total="$total" "BEGIN { printf \"%.1f\\n\", (1 - idle / total) * 100 }"; fi'
build_command_map.pid_container_map: sh -c 'for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do pid=${proc#/proc/}; [ -r "$proc/cgroup" ] || continue; line=$(grep -m1 -E "/docker/[0-9a-f]{12,64}|docker-[0-9a-f]{12,64}\\.scope" "$proc/cgroup" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$line" ] || continue; printf "%s\t%s\n" "$pid" "$line"; done'
build_command_map.thermal:
for f in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp; do [ -r "$f" ] && printf '%s	%s
' "$(cat "$(dirname "$f")/type" 2>/dev/null)" "$(cat "$f")"; done 2>/dev/null
